## Privacy and security review

- [ ] Source images remain local; no upload or telemetry was added.
- [ ] No filename, pixel, metadata, object URL, blob, or preference is sent to a remote service.
- [ ] Untrusted input is not inserted as HTML or evaluated as code.
- [ ] New limits, parsers, storage, network requests, and dependencies are documented.
- [ ] Any new dependency or GitHub Action is justified, license-reviewed, and pinned appropriately.
- [ ] Documentation and the threat model reflect changed trust boundaries.

## Demo media and screenshots

- [ ] No new media is included; or all new media is safe, metadata-minimized, and licensed for redistribution with provenance documented.
- [ ] Screenshots and logs contain no private photo, path, token, hostname, username, or other identifying data.

## Accessibility and compatibility

- [ ] Keyboard and touch interactions still work.
- [ ] Visible controls have useful labels, focus states, and sufficient contrast.
- [ ] Browser-specific HDR behavior is described without claiming universal support.
